positive_controls.description: MATERIALITY (AG-B3-1): an outcome classified 'material' with an otherwise eligible assignment contributes to gross/net/sroiRatio exactly as before (pure applyMaterialityExclusion + runDeterministicCalc; golden pins unchanged).

NO-RATIO (AG-B3-2): with >= 1 defensibly monetized line item the engine emits the numeric ratio exactly as today (sroiRatio number, sroiRatioExact 6dp string, noRatioReason absent) — every pre-existing golden string stays identical.
NO-RATIO persisted: calculateAndPersistSroiRun with >= 1 line item persists a numeric sroi_ratio and snapshotJson.sroiRatio exactly as before (no regression on the numeric path).

COVERAGE: getRunMonetizationCoverage represents every outcome (run line-item outcomes, outcomes with a disposition for the run, project active-assignment outcomes) exactly once, with hasDefensibleMonetization == run has >= 1 line item, and each not_monetized reason kept in its own governed bucket.

COVERAGE consistency: recordOutcomeMonetizationDisposition accepts 'monetized' for an outcome the run monetized and 'not_monetized' + governed reason + justification for an outcome the run excluded; re-recording updates the existing row via UPDATE ... RETURNING (REUSE_EXISTING_VERSIONING) and appends a domain_object_versions row.

FILTERS (AG-B3-4): explicit '0' for each of deadweight/attribution/displacement/dropoff and duration 1 under filterSemantics 'authoritative' yields exactly the same pinned strings as the legacy engine — explicit 0 + justification remains exactly 0.

FILTERS preliminary: under filterSemantics 'preliminary' a NULL filter is coerced as before AND every coerced filter is itemized in CalcResult.preliminaryFilterAssumptions (assignmentId + filter) — preview is labelled preliminary and never silent.

FIBIU-11 UI: the outcomes page renders, per outcome, the human classification form (select material / not_material / unclassified, justification field, current classification state) whose action calls setOutcomeMaterialityClassification, and labels the legacy 1-5 score as 'no determinante'.

FIBIU-12 UI: the run detail page renders, per outcome, a monetization disposition form (disposition, governed reason select with the seven distinct reasons, justification) bound to THIS run by a hidden field the user cannot edit.

FIBIU-12 UI: the run detail page renders the coverage panel ABOVE the review/approval form, with distinct buckets (monetized / material not monetized / per-reason not monetized / missing disposition) and the explicit hasDefensibleMonetization signal, before any approval action is offered.
FIBIU-12 UI: preview, run list, run detail KPI and compare page render an explicit 'Sin ratio SROI' state (never '—' alone, never '0.00:1') when sroiRatio is null.

FIBIU-13 UI: the calculation page renders one discrete justification field per governed filter (deadweight, attribution, displacement, dropoff, duration) wired to upsertSroiFilterSetAction's existing *Justification fields, plus the legacy shared justification field unchanged.

FIBIU-13 UI: each filter shows a visible state distinguishing 'valor 0 justificado' from 'valor desconocido / sin definir' (derived from getFilterJustificationIssues + raw NULL), and the filter inputs no longer default an unset value to '0'.
SERVICE_ZERO_ROW_FAIL_CLOSED positive: when the UPDATE returns the row, the audit event and the version row are recorded exactly once with the returned row as afterJson.

PARSE-NUM: every characterization pin in tests/sroi-parse-num.test.ts stays green — parseNum is unchanged as the display/validation helper (parseNum(null) === 0 remains its documented contract).

STELLA no-ratio propagation positive: with a pinned run carrying a numeric ratio the composer/advisor/validator contexts, prompts and the numeric guard behave exactly as today (parity tests unchanged).

0057 applies on the real baseline (all 72 prior units + 0057 apply clean in the canonical disposable harness; probe asserts outcomes.materiality_classification and _justification columns and the two CHECK constraints exist).
0058 applies (probe asserts the five discrete justification columns exist on sroi_filter_sets, nullable, no CHECK — FIBDB-010 shape).

unique (outcome_id, calculation_run_id) disposition constraint: a second disposition for the same pair is rejected with uq_outcome_monetization_dispositions_outcome_run.

negative_controls.description: MATERIALITY: a 'not_material' outcome with a positive, approved, bound line contributes exactly zero — gross/net/sroiRatio equal the result computed without it, and it is itemized as SkippedAssignment reason 'not_material' (never silently dropped).

MATERIALITY: an unclassified (NULL) outcome never enters the numerator silently — it is itemized in CalcResult.materialityUnclassifiedOutcomeIds, in the preview payload and in the persisted snapshotJson.materialityUnclassifiedOutcomeIds; no MATERIALITY_UNCLASSIFIED eligibility code is emitted (FIBIU-19).
MATERIALITY persisted: calculateAndPersistSroiRun with a not_material outcome persists a run whose line items exclude it and whose snapshot itemizes the exclusion with reason 'not_material'.

NO-RATIO engine: when every assignment is excluded (not_material) the engine emits sroiRatio null, sroiRatioExact null, noRatioReason 'NO_DEFENSIBLE_MONETIZATION', fundersBreakdown [] and unattributedNsvUsd '0.0000', while totalInvestment/gross/net/skippedAssignments are still reported.

NO-RATIO persisted: calculateAndPersistSroiRun in the no-ratio state persists sroi_ratio NULL (never '0.000000'), snapshotJson.sroiRatio null and snapshotJson.noRatioReason set, and still persists the run row (results reporting permitted).

NO-RATIO portfolio: a project whose latest run has sroiRatio null is EXCLUDED with reason 'no_sroi_ratio' — never summed as investment with zero net (no NULL -> net/investment, no NULL -> 0); the pure aggregate and the summary mapper both refuse to fabricate.

NO-RATIO Stella: build-composer-context (pinned run), build-advisor-context and build-validator-context (latest run) with sroi_ratio NULL produce calculationSnapshot.sroiRatio === null (never 0); composer/reviewer/validator prompts serialize sroiRatio null; authorizedNumbersFromSnapshot authorizes no ratio and app/actions/stella/composer.ts passes no null into sroiRatios.
NO-RATIO public verification: app/(public)/verify/[hash]/page.tsx renders 'Sin ratio SROI' for a locked report whose run has sroi_ratio NULL and never renders 'null:1', '0:1' or '0.00:1'.

NO-RATIO comparison: compareCalculationRuns returns sroiRatio delta null when either run carries no ratio (never parseFloat(null || '0')), and the compare page renders the null delta as 'Sin ratio SROI' — never 0.

COVERAGE distinctness: no_defensible_proxy, proxy_not_approved, insufficient_evidence, not_yet_eligible, not_material, superseded_version and other_governed_reason each land in their own bucket — never collapsed into one generic bucket.
COVERAGE missing disposition: an outcome monetized by the run (or active in the project) with no recorded disposition appears in the 'missing_disposition' bucket — it never silently disappears.

COVERAGE consistency refusal: recording 'monetized' for an outcome the run did NOT monetize is refused with a named error (no fabricated coverage); recording 'not_monetized' for an outcome the run DID monetize is refused with a named error.

FILTERS authoritative: a NULL/blank value for any of the five governed filters under filterSemantics 'authoritative' throws a named FILTER_VALUE_UNKNOWN error identifying assignment and filter — no line item and no ratio is computed from an invented zero.
FILTERS persisted: calculateAndPersistSroiRun with a NULL filter throws before any insert — no run row, no line items, no audit event.
SERVICE_ZERO_ROW_FAIL_CLOSED: when db.update(...).returning() yields zero rows, recordOutcomeMonetizationDisposition throws a named error and records NO audit event and NO domain_object_versions row.

APPROVED refusal (service layer, early): recordOutcomeMonetizationDisposition refuses insert and update once an approved review exists for the run (the DB guard remains the authoritative refusal — PG-14).

FIBIU-11 UI: no Stella control classifies materiality — the classification form has no Stella-driven default/prefill and the only write path is the human server action; the legacy score select never writes the classification.
FIBIU-12 UI: the run list never renders '0.00:1' for a run without a ratio; the preview never crashes or renders NaN when sroiRatio is null.
FIBIU-13 UI: an unset filter renders as unknown (not as '0'), and a justified 0 renders as supported — the two states are visually and textually distinct.

Audit verb/object correspondence (FIBC-040, MNB-1 sentinel): every logAuditAction call in the authorized lib/pipeline files keeps an action whose object prefix matches its entityType — verified by the existing static scan.
Tenant boundary sentinel: outcomes/calculation services keep refusing cross-organization project ids (IDOR regressions) — existing negative tests stay green.
0057 materiality vocabulary CHECK: 'material' and 'not_material' accepted; 'unclassified', 'MATERIAL', '' rejected by outcomes_materiality_classification_check.
0057 pair CHECK: classification without justification and justification without classification are rejected by outcomes_materiality_classification_pair_check; both NULL and both set are accepted.
0059 disposition/reason vocabulary CHECK: 'monetized'/'not_monetized' accepted, 'excluded' rejected; each of the seven governed reasons accepted, 'no_reason' rejected.
0059 not_monetized requires reason: disposition 'not_monetized' with reason NULL is rejected by outcome_monetization_dispositions_reason_required_check.
0059 reason/justification pair CHECK: a reason with justification NULL is rejected by outcome_monetization_dispositions_justification_pair_check.

DELETE after 0060: same-tenant runtime DELETE still matches 0 rows (no DELETE policy is added); the owner's DELETE of a pre-approved row succeeds (rolled back) proving the refusal is RLS, not the guard, on the pre-approved path.

Approved-run DB immutability after 0060: UPDATE and DELETE of a disposition whose run has an approved review are rejected with SQLSTATE 42501 by the guard trigger for the runtime identity AND for the table owner (DB-level, not RLS-level); INSERT of a new disposition for an approved run is rejected too; the approval-side trigger takes the exclusive advisory lock (60, hashtext(run_id)) and the guard takes the shared one (measured in pg_locks), and a second session holding the approval lock blocks a disposition UPDATE (lock_timeout) until it commits, after which the UPDATE is refused as approved (TOCTOU closed).

mutation_controls.description: Removing the materiality exclusion (treating not_material like material) makes N-MAT-1 fail: the not_material line would add value to gross/net and change sroiRatio, and the 'not_material' skip entry would be absent.
Removing the unclassified itemization makes N-MAT-2 fail: materialityUnclassifiedOutcomeIds would be missing/empty for a contributing unclassified outcome.
Removing the no-ratio guard (letting netSocialValue.div(totalInvestment) run with zero line items) makes N-RATIO-1/N-RATIO-1b fail: sroiRatio would be 0 instead of null and noRatioReason absent.
Restoring the portfolio fallback (?? net/investment or ?? 0) makes N-RATIO-2 fail: the project would be included with ratio 0 instead of excluded with reason 'no_sroi_ratio'.
Restoring parseFloat(sroiRatio ?? '0') in any Stella context builder makes N-RATIO-3 fail (snapshot ratio 0 instead of null).
Collapsing the per-reason buckets back into a generic 'not_yet_eligible'/'other' bucket makes N-COV-1 fail; dropping outcomes without a disposition makes N-COV-2 fail.

Restoring parseNum(null) -> 0 coercion on the authoritative path (removing the FILTER_VALUE_UNKNOWN refusal) makes N-FILTER-1 and N-FILTER-2 fail: a NULL filter would compute a line at 0% instead of refusing.
Removing .returning()/the zero-row check from the update branch makes N-SVC-1 fail: an audit event and a version row would be recorded for a mutation that never happened.

UPDATE policy removal: inside a rolled-back transaction, DROP POLICY outcome_monetization_dispositions_update makes the PG-12 same-tenant UPDATE match 0 rows again — proving PG-12's positive control is sensitive to the policy.

Approved-run guard removal: inside a rolled-back transaction, DROP TRIGGER trg_outcome_monetization_dispositions_approval_guard lets the owner UPDATE an approved-run disposition (1 row) — proving PG-14 is enforced by the guard and would be caught if removed.

Cross-tenant predicate removal: inside a rolled-back transaction, replacing the update policy's predicate with USING (true) WITH CHECK (true) makes the cross-tenant UPDATE match 1 row — proving PG-12's negative control is sensitive to the tenant predicate.
